title: SC12-T2 — the close (SH04)
line: Go be too busy glowing to look backward.
motionPlan: the FACELOVE stick (a little longer than her hand is wide) stands upright on the mosaic table in the late sun and turns slowly a quarter turn to bring the wordmark to the lens
note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
